transcript: Speaker A: Speak this clearly and fast. Speaker B: इंग्लिश स्पीकिंग सीखना है तो PW Talk ऐप अभी डाउनलोड करो। [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
on_screen_text: Speak this clearly and fast. I want to learn English... But right now... When someone speaks English, I just smile and nod. I understand everything... but I cannot speak. I tried learning... But I didn't practice... Then I found PW Talk... I met RIVA — my AI speaking partner... Start at just ₹7. Want To Improve Your Spoken English? PW TALK APP. DOWNLOAD NOW.
summary: The ad targets learners who understand English but struggle to speak it. It promotes PW Talk's AI partner, RIVA, as a judgment-free way to practice daily for 10-15 minutes. The CTA invites users to download the app and start practicing for ₹7.
